integrity: An analytic proof is supplied, including the matrix-tree reduction, exact cyclic Green kernel, symbol monotonicity, and exponentially uniform Fourier approximation. Standalone exact enumeration checks are corroborating evidence, not substitutes for proofs. No external independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Canonical unweighted wheel graphs only; uniform distribution on distinct spanning-tree incidence vertices. The asymptotic theorem does not identify a least possible finite stabilization threshold. The finite block spectrum is explicit without a complete small-size ordering. No claim is made for arbitrary graph classes or weighted wheels. Independent historical priority confirmation has not occurred.
title: Quadratic vertex-covariance anisotropy of wheel spanning-tree polytopes
